disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全树检索了敏感路径与硬编码凭据（凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据、API Key 等关键词）：源码中未命中任何读取凭据的代码，出现的 token/secret 字样仅为附件上传的一次性随机票据与依赖包名，属正常机制。
checked_items.en: Searched the entire tree for sensitive paths and hardcoded credentials (credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, API keys, etc.): no code reading credentials was found in the source; the token/secret strings that appear are only one-time random tickets for attachment uploads and dependency package names, which are normal mechanisms.

checked_items.zh: 核查凭据读取与网络外联的组合通道：不存在读取敏感文件后再发送出去的代码路径，两段证据均缺失。
checked_items.en: Checked the combined channel of credential reading and outbound network connections: no code path exists that reads sensitive files and then sends them out; both pieces of evidence are missing.

checked_items.zh: 静态预扫中 DSH-C05（映射 DG-R4-53）的 19 处 curl 命中全部位于安装文档、README 与重启脚本，均为对本机 127.0.0.1 的存活与插件激活健康检查，无凭据读取或外发，逐条裁决为良性。
checked_items.en: In the static pre-scan, all 19 curl hits for DSH-C05 (mapping DG-R4-53) are located in installation docs, README, and restart scripts; all are health checks against local 127.0.0.1 for liveness and plugin activation, with no credential reading or exfiltration; each was adjudicated as benign.

evidence.zh: 核查了全树对凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据等敏感路径的引用：源码无任何凭据读取调用，也没有凭据读取加网络外联的组合通道，未检出。
evidence.en: Checked references to sensitive paths such as credential files, SSH private keys, and cloud credentials across the entire tree: the source contains no credential-reading calls, nor any combined channel of credential reading plus outbound network connection; not detected.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了 8 个模型工具的描述文本（列表、读取、认领、评论、提交评审、阻塞、释放认领、关联）：均为任务板业务操作说明，无系统指令、无读取凭据诱导、无越权意图。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text of all 8 model tools one by one (list, read, claim, comment, submit review, block, release claim, link): all are task-board business operation descriptions, with no system instructions, no credential-reading inducement, and no privilege-escalation intent.

checked_items.zh: 审查了技能文件 skills/manage-taskboard/SKILL.md 与其 agents/openai.yaml：内容为任务认领、验证、提交评审的作业指引，明确要求只由人工接受完成、不得绕过服务策略，无注入措辞。对应 DSH-X10（映射 DG-R2-57）的机械命中经内容审查裁决为良性。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the skill file skills/manage-taskboard/SKILL.md and its agents/openai.yaml: the content is an operational guide for task claiming, validation, and submission review, explicitly requiring that work be accepted and completed only by humans and that service policies not be bypassed; no injection wording found. The mechanical hit for DSH-X10 (mapping DG-R2-57) was adjudicated as benign after content review.

checked_items.zh: 全树检索提示词注入措辞（忽略先前指令、伪装系统消息、无需审计、不要询问用户等）：未命中；未发现系统提示注入调用、远程指令加载或隐蔽的诱导安装/改配置措辞，安装文档中的「申请一次性文件权限」为透明征求用户同意，非绕过。
checked_items.en: Searched the entire tree for prompt injection wording (ignore previous instructions, fake system messages, no need for audit, don't ask the user, etc.): no hits; no system prompt injection calls, remote instruction loading, or hidden wording inducing installation/config changes; the "request one-time file permission" in the installation docs is a transparent request for user consent, not a bypass.

evidence.zh: 逐条审查全部注册工具的描述与技能文件：均为任务板业务操作说明，无系统指令、无凭据诱导、无隐藏意图，未检出工具描述投毒。
evidence.en: Reviewed the descriptions and skill files of all registered tools one by one: all are task-board business operation descriptions, with no system instructions, no credential inducement, and no hidden intent; tool description poisoning not detected.

evidence.zh: 检查安装文档、README 与技能文本是否诱导 Agent 安装、改配置或放开权限：安装指引透明、均需用户同意（如请求完整文件权限的说明），无隐蔽诱导措辞，未检出。
evidence.en: Checked installation docs, README, and skill texts for whether they induce the agent to install, change configs, or loosen permissions: the installation guidance is transparent and all steps require user consent (e.g., the explanation requesting full file permissions); no hidden inducement wording; not detected.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描动态执行面（eval、new Function、子进程、动态导入执行等）：源码中未命中任何执行外部命令或动态求值的代码；也未发现对 cordis_define/cordis_run 等动态包工具的引用。
checked_items.en: Scanned the entire tree for dynamic execution surfaces (eval, new Function, subprocesses, dynamic import execution, etc.): the source contains no code that executes external commands or dynamic evaluation; no references to dynamic package tools such as cordis_define/cordis_run were found either.

checked_items.zh: package.json 无任何安装钩子（无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）；仓库无 husky、lefthook、devcontainer、Makefile、gitmodules 等树内执行载体；CI 工作流仅做构建与测试且权限只读，对应 DSH-X07（映射 DG-R3-59）的命中裁决为良性。
checked_items.en: package.json has no install hooks (no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); the repository has no in-tree execution carriers such as husky, lefthook, devcontainer, Makefile, or gitmodules; the CI workflow only builds and tests with read-only permissions; the hit for DSH-X07 (mapping DG-R3-59) was adjudicated as benign.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 的两处 !!js 表达式（对应 DSH-P01，映射 DG-R3-51）为数据库路径与附件目录的环境变量回退写法（process.env 加默认值），与 dsh 官方基础配置同款，无恶意载荷，裁决为良性。
checked_items.en: The two !!js expressions in the patch config cordis.patch.yml (corresponding to DSH-P01, mapping DG-R3-51) are environment-variable fallback patterns for the database path and attachment directory (process.env plus default values), same as the official dsh base config; no malicious payload; adjudicated as benign.

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle 专项核查：键盘监听（对应 DSH-X05，映射 DG-R3-57）仅为 Escape 关闭弹窗的常规 UI 行为，未捕获键盘内容、未访问剪贴板、未调用凭据 RPC；超长行与转义密度命中（对应 DSH-X08，映射 DG-R3-60）均为 JSX 渲染、界面文案字典与文件名清洗正则，无混淆载荷。
checked_items.en: Special check on the client bundle: the keyboard listener (corresponding to DSH-X05, mapping DG-R3-57) is only a normal UI behavior for closing popups with Escape; it does not capture keyboard content, does not access the clipboard, and does not call credential RPCs; the overly-long-line and escape-density hits (corresponding to DSH-X08, mapping DG-R3-60) are JSX rendering, UI text dictionaries, and filename-cleaning regexes, with no obfuscated payload.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置含两处 !!js 表达式，经核查为数据库与附件目录的环境变量回退写法（官方基础配置同款），非恶意载荷；配置仅插入插件自身，不触碰安全行，未检出 patch 即 RCE。
evidence.en: The patch config contains two !!js expressions, which after review are environment-variable fallback patterns for the database and attachment directory (same as the official base config), not malicious payloads; the config only inserts the plugin itself, does not touch security lines, and no patch-to-RCE was detected.

evidence.zh: 全树未发现对 cordis_define/cordis_run 等宿主动态执行工具的引用，源码亦无 eval/new Function/子进程调用，未检出自我修改滥用。
evidence.en: No references to host dynamic execution tools such as cordis_define/cordis_run were found across the entire tree; the source also has no eval/new Function/subprocess calls; self-modification abuse not detected.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装钩子；无 husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile/gitmodules 等执行载体；CI 工作流仅构建测试且权限只读，未检出安装期或构建期恶意执行。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hooks; no execution carriers such as husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile/gitmodules; the CI workflow only builds and tests with read-only permissions; no malicious execution during install or build was detected.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client；客户端 bundle 专项核查：键盘监听仅为关闭弹窗的 UI 行为，无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭据 RPC 滥用，附件上传走回环一次性票据，未检出客户端恶意行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares dsh.client; special check on the client bundle: the keyboard listener is only UI behavior for closing popups, with no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC abuse; attachment uploads use loopback one-time tickets; no malicious client behavior detected.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部出站网络调用：源码中唯一的 fetch 指向本机回环的附件上传票据地址，无外部域名、无 WebSocket、无编码变换后外发的链路。
checked_items.en: Scanned all outbound network calls: the only fetch in the source points to the loopback attachment-upload ticket address; no external domains, no WebSocket, and no chain that exfiltrates data via encoding transforms.

checked_items.zh: 未发现凭据读取加外联的组合通道；文档与运维脚本中的 curl（对应 DSH-C05，映射 DG-R4-53）均为对本机 127.0.0.1 的健康检查，逐条裁决为良性。
checked_items.en: No combined channel of credential reading plus outbound connection was found; the curl calls in docs and operations scripts (corresponding to DSH-C05, mapping DG-R4-53) are all health checks against local 127.0.0.1; each was adjudicated as benign.

checked_items.zh: 客户端无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或向外部端点发送数据的代码；RPC 写操作显式要求回环连接。
checked_items.en: The client has no code for keylogging, clipboard theft, or sending data to external endpoints; RPC write operations explicitly require a loopback connection.

evidence.zh: 全树出站网络核查：运行时代码仅向本机回环发起附件上传，无外部端点、无编码外发、无凭据外泄通道，未检出。
evidence.en: Outbound network check across the entire tree: runtime code only issues attachment uploads to the local loopback, with no external endpoints, no encoded exfiltration, and no credential leakage channel; not detected.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单核对：运行时依赖仅 zod，peer 依赖全部为官方 @deepseek-ai/* 包、cordis 与 react，无仿冒包名、无浮动 git 依赖、无远程加载即执行。
checked_items.en: Dependency manifest verification: the only runtime dependency is zod; all peer dependencies are official @deepseek-ai/* packages, cordis, and react; no impersonating package names, no floating git dependencies, and no remote load-and-execute.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置仅新增 taskboard 插件自身的配置行，未覆盖 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled:true，也无通过环境变量降权限的写法；配置注入为官方基础配置同款的环境变量回退，未改写 inject/intercept。
checked_items.en: The patch config only adds the config lines for the taskboard plugin itself; it does not override security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, has no disabled:true, and has no pattern that lowers permissions via environment variables; the config injection is the same environment-variable fallback as the official base config, and does not rewrite inject/intercept.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）的抢先监听或审批链截断行为；首次审计无版本基线，无法比对 manifest 能力声明突变（跨版本升级自动激活场景不适用）。
checked_items.en: No preemptive listening on security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests) or approval-chain truncation was found; this is the first audit and no version baseline exists, so a comparison of manifest capability declaration mutations is not possible (the cross-version auto-activation scenario is not applicable).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入 taskboard 插件行，未覆盖 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全配置，无 disabled:true 或权限降权写法，未检出安全行覆盖。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the taskboard plugin line; it does not override security configs such as sandbox/approval/permission, has no disabled:true or permission-lowering patterns; security-line override not detected.

evidence.zh: 未发现对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）的抢先监听或截断调用，审批链未被短路，未检出。
evidence.en: No preemptive listening on security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests) or truncation calls was found; the approval chain is not short-circuited; not detected.

evidence.zh: 本报告为首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法执行跨版本 manifest 能力声明突变的比对，不适用。
evidence.en: This report is the first audit; there is no previous version baseline for comparison, so a cross-version manifest capability declaration mutation comparison cannot be performed; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept，未给安全插件追加必需服务造成 pending，未检出注入配置篡改。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite inject/intercept, does not append required services to security plugins causing pending, and patch config tampering was not detected.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动监听服务；向宿主 webserver 注册的附件字节路由以回环认证 RPC 发放的一次性票据保护，非回环传输对变更类端点显式强制只读。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a listening service on its own; the attachment byte route registered with the host webserver is protected by one-time tickets issued via loopback-authenticated RPC, and for non-loopback transports, change-type endpoints are explicitly forced read-only.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（动态防线未启用），运行时行为结论仅基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (the dynamic defense line is not enabled); runtime behavior conclusions are based solely on static analysis.

checked_items.zh: 宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属生态固有风险，非本插件引入；插件自身已用回环权威与一次性票据做了缓解。
checked_items.en: The host's local RPC lacking an authentication layer is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin; the plugin itself has mitigated it with loopback authority and one-time tickets.

evidence.zh: 插件不自行监听端口；向宿主 webserver 注册的附件路由以回环认证 RPC 发放的一次性票据保护，非回环传输对写操作强制只读；宿主无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险而非本插件问题，未检出插件侧新增暴露面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen on ports itself; the attachment route registered with the host webserver is protected by one-time tickets issued via loopback-authenticated RPC, and write operations are forced read-only for non-loopback transports; the host's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk rather than a plugin issue; no new exposure surface on the plugin side was detected.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：dsh.bundle/client 声明完整，作者与包名无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: dsh.bundle/client declarations are complete, and the author and package name show no signs of impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：27 条机械命中全部逐条裁决为良性（环境变量配置写法、文档与脚本本机健康检查、UI 常规键盘监听、超长行与文件名清洗正则）。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 27 mechanical hits were adjudicated one by one as benign (environment-variable config patterns, local health checks in docs and scripts, normal UI keyboard listening, overly-long-line and filename-cleaning regexes).

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无出站外联。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reading, and no outbound connections.

summary.zh: 模型面审查通过：工具描述与技能文件均无注入措辞。
summary.en: Model-surface review passed: neither tool descriptions nor skill files contain injection wording.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no sandbox artifacts).

limits.zh: 动态沙箱未启用（动态防线不适用，未做动态验证），运行时结论仅基于静态分析。任务卡无上一版报告，属首版完整审计。能力声明取自代码实测（package.json 未显式声明能力字段）：无网络、无 shell、文件写入限于插件自身配置根（SQLite 数据库与附件目录）、模型面开启。未逐字通读的文件：二进制图片/动图资源、锁文件、构建配置、第三方声明与 LICENSE，以及 tests 目录下的规格文件（已通过关键词扫描覆盖关键风险模式）；这些文件不影响上述结论。静态预扫 27 条命中全部逐条裁决为良性（见各维度检测痕迹与场景核查），未产出发现项。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox is not enabled (the dynamic defense line is not applicable, no dynamic verification was done), and runtime conclusions are based solely on static analysis. The task card has no previous version report, so this is a first-version full audit. Capability declarations are taken from actual code measurement (package.json does not explicitly declare capability fields): no network, no shell, file writes are limited to the plugin's own config root (SQLite database and attachment directory), and the model surface is enabled. Files not read word-for-word: binary image/GIF assets, lock files, build configs, third-party declarations and LICENSE, and spec files under the tests directory (key risk patterns were covered via keyword scanning); these files do not affect the above conclusions. All 27 static pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one as benign (see the detection traces and scenario checks for each dimension), with no findings produced.
